title: I DON’T SHARE THE WORD OF GOD FOR MONEY.
paragraphs: I DON’T SHARE THE WORD OF GOD FOR MONEY.
Some people accuse me of using the Bible just for content monetization… but NOPE, I DO NOT.
In fact, my Facebook has been blocked from monetization since I started sharing God’s Word. And you know what? I DON'T CARE. Because this is not for me. This is for HIS GLORY ALONE.

If I wanted to make money, I could have done many other things. But I keep sharing the truth because souls matter more than money. I don’t preach for views, likes, or clout—I preach because people need Jesus.
And no amount of blockage, restriction, or accusation will stop me from doing God’s work.

"For we do not preach ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus' sake."
— 2 Corinthians 4:5
To those who believe, thank you for standing with me. To those who doubt, may the Lord open your heart. ❤️
